title: WitnessPayloadV2
description: The JSON a trooth.witness-statement.v2 payload holds. Its members are signed in exactly this order with no whitespace. It binds the check mapping, the evaluator, the subject scope and the evidence manifest.

reading_id.description: The id of the reading. Also usable as trooth:reading:<reading_id> (docs/IDS.md).

domain.description: The domain the reading was taken of: lowercase, no trailing dot.

read_at.description: When Trooth took the reading, as Trooth asserts it when signing. There is no independent timestamp. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

methodology.description: The check mapping, bound by digest.

evaluator.description: The software that took the reading.

evidence_manifest.description: The evidence manifest, bound by digest.

counts.description: Counts that must agree with the checks.

Check.title: Check
Check.description: One check in the reading and its outcome.

id.description: The check id in the check mapping the payload names (for example S1, L2).

category.description: The check category in the mapping (for example security, legal, ai, ip, business).

kind.description: How the check is taken: `probe` reads the public surface; `attest` reads something the company published about itself.

outcome.description: One of three outcomes. There is no fourth value and no score.

reason.description: Null when the outcome is `as expected`; otherwise why.

CheckReason.title: CheckReason
CheckReason.description: Why a check is not `as expected`. Present on every check whose outcome is `not read` or `not as expected`.

code.description: The reason code. source_unavailable, timeout, evaluator_limitation, carried_from_earlier_reading and check_misconfigured go with `not read`; contrary_observation and expected_item_absent go with `not as expected`.

version.description: The version of the reason vocabulary.

source_ref.description: The public source the reason refers to, or null. Always null when `withheld` is true.

withheld.description: True when the source behind this reason is not published (for example a private document); only a commitment to it is in the evidence manifest.

withheld_reason.description: Why the source is withheld. Required, non-empty, when `withheld` is true; otherwise null.

Counts.title: Counts
Counts.description: Counts that MUST agree with the checks: read + not_read = in_reading; as_expected + not_as_expected = read; in_reading = the number of checks. They are reported apart and never added into one number.

read.description: Checks whose outcome is not `not read`.

not_as_expected.description: Checks whose outcome is `not as expected`.

domain.description: The domain read. Equals the payload domain.

surface.description: Which surface was read. `public`: only what anyone can fetch.

checks_in_scope.description: The number of checks in scope. Equals the number of checks listed.

Methodology.title: Methodology
Methodology.description: The exact check mapping the reading used, bound by digest.

standard.description: The name of the standard the mapping belongs to.

mapping_url.description: Where the exact mapping bytes are served. Immutable versions live under https://trooth.co/standard/check-mapping/.

mapping_digest.description: `sha256:` plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact mapping bytes.

Evaluator.title: Evaluator
Evaluator.description: The software that took the reading.

EvidenceManifestRef.title: EvidenceManifestRef
EvidenceManifestRef.description: The evidence manifest the reading binds, by digest.

digest.description: `sha256:` plus the hex SHA-256 of the canonical manifest bytes (evidence-manifest.schema.json).

canonicalization.description: How the manifest bytes are formed: entries sorted by check_id, keys check_id then source or commitment, no whitespace, UTF-8.
